title: Trace a bounded agent run
description: Choose a task, planning policy, tool signal, run budget, and approval boundary. The trace uses fixed teaching costs, not provider pricing or benchmark claims.

tasks.label: Summarize a support case
tasks.detail: Read one assigned case and draft a cited summary without changing external state.
tasks.successCriterion: A draft cites the current case record and no external record changes.
tasks.unsafeConsequence: The run follows injected text and proposes sending case data outside the assigned workflow.

steps.label: Bind goal and success check
steps.detail: Record the case ID, read-only scope, and required citation.

steps.label: Read assigned case
steps.detail: Fetch the authoritative case record through a scoped read tool.

steps.label: Draft from evidence
steps.detail: Generate a summary from validated record fields.

steps.label: Verify cited fields
steps.detail: Compare the draft with the authoritative case record.

tasks.label: Resolve a duplicate charge
tasks.detail: Inspect one account, propose a refund, execute it once, and verify the ledger.
tasks.successCriterion: One approved refund is linked to one operation ID and the ledger confirms the final state.
tasks.unsafeConsequence: Untrusted tool text steers the run toward an unrelated data export or an unapproved financial action.

steps.label: Bind goal and constraints
steps.detail: Record the account, amount ceiling, and required ledger proof.

steps.label: Inspect the ledger
steps.detail: Read the two candidate charges from the assigned account.

steps.label: Propose one refund
steps.detail: Select the duplicate charge and bind an operation ID.

steps.label: Execute refund
steps.detail: Request the financial mutation through the tool gateway.

steps.label: Verify ledger state
steps.detail: Read by operation ID and confirm exactly one refund.

steps.label: Return verified outcome
steps.detail: Report the ledger result, not the model's unsupported claim.

tasks.label: Publish an incident update
tasks.detail: Read service evidence, draft a status update, publish once, and verify the public revision.
tasks.successCriterion: The approved update matches current telemetry and one public revision is visible.
tasks.unsafeConsequence: Injected telemetry content becomes an unauthorized publication or redirects the run to an unrelated tool.

steps.label: Bind incident and audience
steps.detail: Record the incident ID, approved channel, and release criteria.

steps.label: Read incident evidence
steps.detail: Fetch current metrics and the incident commander's notes.

steps.label: Draft bounded update
steps.detail: State only claims supported by current incident evidence.

steps.label: Publish revision
steps.detail: Create one public status revision through the scoped publisher.

steps.label: Verify public revision
steps.detail: Read the status page and compare the published revision ID.

policies.label: Fixed workflow
policies.detail: Use a predefined sequence and stop on unexpected results.

policies.label: Plan, execute, replan once
policies.detail: Create an explicit plan and allow one bounded recovery decision.

policies.label: Open reactive loop
policies.detail: Replan after observations but pass raw tool text back as instructions. This is intentionally unsafe.

signals.label: Valid tool result
signals.detail: The first tool returns a schema-valid result tied to the requested object.

signals.label: Transient read outage
signals.detail: The first read fails before any external mutation occurs.

signals.label: Injected tool output
signals.detail: A result contains valid data plus text asking the runtime to export unrelated records.

approvals.label: No approval gate
approvals.detail: The runtime executes any authorized proposal immediately.

approvals.label: Approve external writes
approvals.detail: Pause before financial, publishing, messaging, or record mutations.

approvals.label: Approve every tool call
approvals.detail: Pause before reads and writes. This is safest but adds high review load.
